claims.text: Palmaia sits between the jungle and the ocean on Mexico's Riviera Maya.

findings.quote: Palmaïa is a groundbreaking wellness concept nestled between the jungle and the ocean on Mexico’s Riviera Maya

claims.text: The resort is located on the most southern point of Playa del Carmen.

findings.quote: Palmaïa is located on the most southern point of Playa del Carmen

claims.text: The resort is surrounded by 400 hectares of virgin jungle.

findings.quote: surrounded by 400 hectares of virgin jungle

claims.text: Cancun airport is about a 45-minute drive away.

findings.quote: Close enough to be an easy 45min drive to Cancun airport

claims.text: The resort was deliberately built up rather than out to preserve as much of the land and natural landscape as possible.

findings.quote: we made a conscious decision to build our resort up and not out—to preserve as much of the revered land and natural landscape as possible

claims.text: Pathways lead through the jungle to yoga decks, cenotes and spa treatment temples.

findings.quote: Wandering pathways undulate between trees and plants and rocks and lead to quiet yoga decks, tranquil cenotes, and peaceful spa treatment temples.

claims.text: Wildlife on the grounds includes sereques, coatis, spider monkeys, iguanas and armadillos.

findings.quote: From Sereques, the lovable rodents who aren’t shy, and Coati with their ring-like tails, to Spider Monkeys, Igauanas and Armadillos

claims.text: All suites are free of animal products.

findings.quote: Respecting nature, all suites are free of animal products choosing compassion over violence

claims.text: Palmaia uses a one-rate all-inclusive system where guests pay once.

findings.quote: We have a one rate system (all-inclusive) where you pay once and everything is included\*.

claims.text: The AiA Wellness program offers more than 50 holistic and health activities every week, led by in-house and visiting guides.

findings.quote: More than 50 holistic and health activities carried out every week by our in-house and visiting guides.

claims.text: Indigenous healing at Atlantis Spa is practiced by medicine-men and women whose knowledge has often been passed down through generations.

findings.quote: the ancient wisdom of indigenous healing is practiced by skilled medicine-men and women whose knowledge in many cases has been passed down through generations

claims.text: The Nourishing Biome food program removes the most toxic ingredients of the modern food system.

findings.quote: Instead of dictating what you should eat, we simplify by removing the most toxic ingredients in the modern food system.

claims.text: A woven wooden tunnel leads from the rooms to the beach, and elevated walkways wind through the jungle canopy.

findings.quote: A meandering woven wooden tunnel is a passageway from your room to the beach, and elevated walkways wind through foliage that forms a protective canopy overhead

claims.text: Atlantis Spa sits among ancient rock formations, jungle, natural cenotes and mangroves.

findings.quote: Atlantis Spa emerges as a mystical sanctuary nestled among ancient rock formations, lush jungle, natural cenotes and endemic mangroves.

claims.text: Spa treatments are carried out in temples integrated into the jungle.

findings.quote: Treatments are carried out in our beautiful Temples perfectly integrated into the natural surroundings of the Jungle.

claims.text: All suites are oceanfront.

findings.quote: 234 Oceanfront Suites
findings.note: all suites are listed as oceanfront suites

findings.quote: All 234 suites are designed to make you relax

claims.text: Remnants of Mayan sacred sites still exist on the land, outside of public view.

findings.quote: This is a land where remnants of Mayan sacred sites still exist, outside of public view.

claims.text: There are no roads to Palmaia; guests enter a private residential development and cross a neighbouring resort by golf cart to reach it.

findings.quote: There are no roads or streets to Palmaïa, therefore the only way of accessing is through another neighbouring resort. This system allows a double layer of security as you have to enter a private residential development and then cross a resort by golf cart

claims.text: Spa, private dinners and private one-on-one sessions may carry extra charges.

findings.quote: \*Certain services may have extra charges like Spa, Private Dinners, Private 1:1 sessions, boutique, etc.

claims.text: Beginning November 1, 2026, Palmaia welcomes children aged 10 and above.

findings.quote: beginning November 1st, 2026, we will welcome children aged 10 years and above
